title: Study on the Difference of Axilo-rectal Temperature in Appendicitis
brief_summary: The investigators are studying prospectively the difference in axilo-rectal temperature in patients with acute appendicitis and using as a control group patients consulting with acute gastroenteritis at our emergency unit.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with acute appendicitis
* Patients with acute gastroenteritis
* Patients older than 15 years of age

Exclusion Criteria:

* Other acute abdominal diseases
study_population: Patients consulting in the emergency unit with acute appendicitis or acute gastroenteritis
